pr_title: Fix action exact match (Also fixes ui_ focus keys)
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/54602
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/55622
Supersedes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/54842

3.x version: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/54174

Previously, `event.is_action_pressed("test", false, true)` always returned false, while `event.is_action_released("test", false, true)` returned true both for pressed and released. This is because the pressed pointer was not passed into `is_match`. This PR fixes it by using `action_match` instead.

MRP: [Test10.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/7404122/Test10.zip)
pr_comments: Thanks for reviewing, sorry for missing those extra consts so many times now! Should be ready now.

issue_context.title: "ui_right" and "ui_up" keys do not work for focusing neighbors
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0.dev.calinou [4f298237b]

### System information

Windows 11, 1060 GT

### Issue description

As seen in the video below, both automatic and focus cannot be changed using the arrow keys (default ui controls)

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38346332/144704813-099bd01e-4cc0-41a8-9dba-f6fdbf1b5194.mp4

surprisingly, ui_focus_next and ui_focus_previous are fully functional. (TAB / SHIFT + TAB)


### Steps to reproduce

1. Create an empty project
3. Create buttons and put them in arbitrary locations, or in containers such as VBox/HBox/Grid
2. (optional) manually assign focus neighbors
3. run the project and click on one button
4. try to change the focused button using arrow keys (up and right do not work)

### Minimal reproduction project

[ui_focus_min.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/7654188/ui_focus_min.zip)
comments:
Related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/54602.

@lentsius-bark The minimal reproduction project failed to upload, as you submitted the issue before it was done uploading. Please edit your post and upload it again 🙂

@Calinou fixed, thanks for letting me know!

Yeah something funny must be going on behind the scenes, as with control nodes, ui_next and ui_previous are the ones that work 100% of the time.

review_comments:
I'm a bit concerned about the potential impact of this change on joypad motion events.

I guess let's merge and assess while testing whether this is working as expected.
